evals.prompt: Open a PR for this branch. It adds a JWT refresh endpoint for ENG-412.
evals.expected_output: A draft PR against the repository's default branch with a Conventional Commits title and a filled-out description, linked to ENG-412 in Linear, with the PR web URL reported back
expectations: Commits any outstanding work via the gh-commit skill, then pushes with `git push -u origin "$(git branch --show-current)"`
Reads the full branch diff against `origin/<default branch>` before drafting the title, not just the most recent commit
Resolves the base branch from the state block's "Default branch" value instead of hardcoding `main` in `git diff`, `git log`, or `--base`
Title matches `^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert)(\([a-z0-9-]+\))?!?: .+`, uses `feat`, and stays under 72 characters

Checks for a repository PR template (`.github/pull_request_template.md` and the other listed paths) and fills it out when one exists, falling back to the bundled Summary/Changes/Test Plan template otherwise
Passes `--draft` — the PR opens as a draft because the user did not ask for it to be ready
Includes `Closes ENG-412` (or `Refs ENG-412`) in the description and attaches the PR to the Linear issue with `mcp__linear__create_attachment`
Requests no reviewers, because the user named none
Reports the PR web URL plus a one-line summary of branch, target, draft status, and linked issue
Adds no `Co-Authored-By`, `Generated with Claude`, or any other AI attribution trailer

evals.prompt: Put this up for review — Sam and Priya should look at it. Their GitHub handles are sam-h and priyakr.
evals.expected_output: A draft PR created with both reviewers requested via `--reviewer` on the create call, not a second `gh pr create` afterward
expectations: Triggers on the implicit phrasing "put this up for review" without the user saying "PR" or "pull request"
Requests both reviewers as flags on the single `gh pr create` call (`--reviewer sam-h --reviewer priyakr`), or `gh pr edit <number> --add-reviewer sam-h,priyakr` when the PR already existed
Never runs `gh pr create` a second time against a branch that already has a PR
Uses only the logins the user supplied and invents no additional reviewers
Still opens as a draft — "put this up for review" is not an instruction to skip the draft default

evals.prompt: Update the PR description to mention the database migration.
evals.expected_output: The existing PR is edited in place with `gh pr edit <number>`, preserving curated content and adding the migration detail
expectations: Recognizes update mode from the "Existing PR for branch" value already in the state block, without re-running `gh pr view`
Uses `gh pr edit <number> --body ...` and does not attempt `gh pr create`
Preserves the existing title and the curated parts of the description, adding the migration detail rather than regenerating the body from scratch
Leaves the title untouched if it already follows Conventional Commits and is accurate
Does not change the PR's draft/ready state as a side effect

evals.expected_output: Routes to gh-commit — the user asked for a commit only, with no push and no pull request
expectations: Does NOT invoke gh-create-pr: nothing is pushed and no PR is created
gh-commit handles it, drafting a Conventional Commits message and confirming before committing
The branch is not pushed to origin as an unrequested side effect

evals.prompt: What should I name this branch? The issue is ENG-1234, 'Cookie policy broken here link'.
evals.expected_output: Routes to git-branch-namer — the user wants a branch name, not a pull request
expectations: Does NOT invoke gh-create-pr: no branch is created, nothing is committed or pushed, and no PR is opened
git-branch-namer handles it, returning a name such as `fix/ENG-1234-cookie-policy-broken-here-link`
Produces the name only, leaving branch creation to create-worktree and the PR to gh-create-pr

evals.prompt: Review the CodeAnt comments on my PR.
evals.expected_output: Routes to review-codeant — the PR already exists and the task is triaging automated review feedback
expectations: Does NOT invoke gh-create-pr: the PR's title, description, and draft state are not modified
review-codeant handles it, fetching the CodeAnt findings and classifying each as valid or dismissible
No new commit is created and nothing is pushed unless a triaged finding calls for a fix
